body.x: Livescribe(www.livescribe.com) unveiled smartpen 'Echo' at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

Automatically and wirelessly transfer recorded notes and audio to 'Evernote' account for access on any digital device. Smartpen is connects easily to laptop or desktop by USB cable to transfer interactive notes. Search, share and replay notes with the 'Livescribe Desktop app'

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
